items.title: Massive Phishing Attack Impersonate as Travel Brands Attacking Users with 4,300 Malicious Domains
items.description: A large phishing campaign has been targeting travelers worldwide, using more than 4,300 fake domains to steal payment card information. The operation focuses on people planning vacations or about to check into hotels by sending fake booking confirmation emails that appear to come from trusted travel companies. items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Vulnerability Enables Cross-Site Scripting Attacks
items.description: Cloud Software Group has disclosed a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability affecting NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway products. Tracked as CVE-2025-12101, the flaw allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, potentially leading to session hijacking, data theft, or unauthorized actions.
